name: Ty Jerome
headline: Ty Jerome is playing like Memphis's top scorer at 26.2 points a night, but the team has slid to 1-4 in its last five.
good: He is averaging 26.2 points, 4.8 assists and 3.5 rebounds in 30.8 minutes over 10 games, all as a starter.
He is very efficient for a high-volume guard: 62.5% true shooting on a 32.1% usage rate, with 36.6% from three and 89.7% at the line.
He has had two huge nights: 45 points on 17 of 25 against Utah on Oct 22 and 40 points on 14 of 22 against New Orleans on Nov 3.
The grade file gives him an A (90) for elite production in his minutes, and his impact score is 42.0 with a +8.4 plus-minus per game.
bad: Scoring has cooled off a bit since the 40-point game: 23, 21, 27 and 22 points in the next four, and he shot 1 of 5 from three against Denver on Nov 12.
He has had quiet shooting nights, like 3 of 12 against Portland (10 points) and 4 of 15 against Utah on Oct 27 (15 points).
He turns it over 2.5 times a game, with 5 giveaways in the preseason opener and 4 each against Golden State, New Orleans and Indiana.
fans: Coverage has focused on his scoring breakout, with Roundtable crediting more shot volume, better conditioning and a looser mindset for the jump to roughly 26 points a game. NBA.com and CBS Sports describe him as an unlikely scoring leader who is locked in as the starting point guard. I did not find reddit threads or much critical analysis in the search results, so the fan mood here is mostly positive but thinly sourced.
outlook: Memphis (7-4) visits New Orleans (4-8) tonight, Friday Nov 13, with the Grizzlies listed as 3.5 point favorites. The Pelicans were the team he scored 40 against earlier this month, so expect a big scoring role again as Memphis tries to snap a 1-4 stretch.
